scope: One visual concept based on the current game's DualGrid approach and the user's original protagonist. No tile production or Unity changes.
purpose: Review a simpler hand-drawn cave art direction that can later be decomposed into small terrain tiles and separate ecological objects.
productionMethod: Built-in image generation for a large concept image. Exact small tiles, alpha masks and slopes would use deterministic tools in a later authorized slice.
transparency: Opaque scene preview. Future terrain, background, mineral and ecology layers must be separate.
sharedEdgesAndShapePrecision: The concept demonstrates a restrained contour vocabulary only. It does not certify the 16 four-corner masks, tile edge pixels, slope geometry, collision or animation.

imageReferences.role: Character identity and drawing style: cyan round hood, beige face, simple features, tiny body and black linework.
Existing four-corner tile structure and repeatable contour vocabulary; simplify the detailed rock treatment for the protagonist.

direction: Orthographic side view; thin lit rims and inner shadow bands convey solid rock thickness.
Small repeatable rock groups, restrained cracks, flat warm earth and cool slate color blocks.
Terrain assembled from solid areas, straight edges, inner and outer corners, shallow and 45-degree slopes.
Quiet dark background preserves the character silhouette.
Sparse independent grass, mushrooms, exposed ore and one short water drop suggest detachable dynamic layers.
preserve: Original protagonist files, prior concepts, failed reviews and runtime candidates.
Current game, dependencies, terrain state, slope geometry and player saves.
